description: This file defines the RegexChannelNamespacePredicate class, which implements the IChannelNamespacePredicate interface to filter stream namespaces using regular expressions. It includes a constructor to initialize the regex and a method to check if a namespace matches the pattern.

classes.name: RegexChannelNamespacePredicate
classes.description: Implements IChannelNamespacePredicate to filter stream namespaces based on a regex pattern.

methods.name: PredicatePattern
methods.description: Returns the regex pattern prefixed with 'regex:' to describe this predicate.

methods.name: RegexChannelNamespacePredicate
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the regex with the provided pattern, throwing ArgumentNullException if null.

methods.name: IsMatch
methods.description: Checks if the given stream namespace matches the regex pattern.
